question: Why is DNS resolution via UDP slower than TCP on Mac?
answer: My understanding is that DNS queries via UDP (the default) should be faster, but I am seeing the opposite on two Macs I own, and other 3 people I have asked who are also on Mac, see exactly the same thing. It's weird, but queries over UDP are 3-5 times slower than queries over TCP. I cannot reproduce this on my Linux servers for example.On my Macs I switched to DNS over TLS which is much faster than the default UDP querying for me, but I am still curious.
